description: SPAIN. Non-resident income tax (IRNR) for 2026 on the imputed income of a home a non-resident keeps without letting it: 2% (or 1.1%) of the cadastral value, taxed at 24% (19% for EU/EEA residents).

eu_eea_resident.description: Resident of an EU/EEA state (19%); otherwise 24% (UK, Canada, USA…).

values_revised.description: Municipal cadastral values revised in the last ten years (1.1%).

name: non_resident_tax_es
title: Spanish non-resident tax on a home that is not let
